set.body: Move the dependency-free JVM/Scala.js Zarr kernel and optional Blosc/Zstd provider into standalone canardlapin/zarr4s; keep NeuroArchive and ScalaFIM dataset/response adapters in scalafim; rewire through a local override and immutable GitHub revision; preserve serialized NeuroArchive payload identifiers; require upstream and downstream JVM/Scala.js gates.
set.title: Extract generic Zarr kernel to zarr4s
